coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a headless-browser pass over each vendor's partner locator with country=Slovakia (or capture the underlying XHR/API), snapshot the resulting partner names and addresses, then reconcile them against finstat.sk / registeruz.sk entities.

coverage_gaps.description: Finastra, Oracle Financial Services, PAX, Nexi and Temenos' own newsroom/client-stories sections were not individually crawled in this pass; only aggregate or third-party pages were reached.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Direct-crawl each vendor's customers/case-studies/newsroom index and run an on-site search for 'Slovakia', 'Slovak', 'Bratislava' and each SK bank name.

coverage_gaps.description: The GDPR processor-list pattern that revealed Diebold Nixdorf at Slovenská sporiteľňa was only found for one bank; equivalent disclosures for VÚB, Tatra banka, ČSOB, Prima banka, 365.bank/Poštová banka, mBank, UniCredit Bank Slovakia and Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka were not collected.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each SK bank, locate the 'ochrana osobných údajov / zoznam sprostredkovateľov a príjemcov' page and archive the supplier list; diff annually. This is likely the single highest-yield vendor-relationship source for SK.

coverage_gaps.description: State-controlled or public-sector-adjacent banking bodies (NBS, Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka, Exportno-importná banka SR) publish tenders and contracts that name vendors; this channel was not touched in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cross-check vendor names against Vestník verejného obstarávania (uvo.gov.sk) and the central contract register (crz.gov.sk) to catch relationships never published as case studies.

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor case studies carry no reliable publication dates in search snippets; the Temenos/Tatra banka item's currency and go-live status were not confirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For every captured case study record both first-seen date and any on-page date; confirm status via the client bank's own annual report or press page before treating it as a current relationship.

coverage_gaps.description: Beyond Printec Slovakia and Asseco CE, the SK integrator/reseller layer (local software houses reselling foreign core, card, fraud and POS platforms) is not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snowball from Slovak IT-sector associations (ITAS), bank job postings naming platforms, and vendor partner locators to build an SK integrator roster, then verify each in the obchodný register.

brief: For Slovakia, international banking-tech and payments vendors publish very little country-specific evidence: their case-study hubs (Diebold Nixdorf, Auriga, NCR Atleos, Comarch, Backbase, Worldline/Ingenico, IDEMIA) are worth monitoring as pointer surfaces but yielded almost no SK-named story in this pass, and none of them maintain Slovak-language content. The genuinely SK-specific vendor evidence sits with Slovak-domiciled or Slovak-operating vendors that publish local references — above all Asseco Central Europe's sk-language 'Referencie' and press sections, and Printec Slovakia's country page — plus partner locators (Verifone's, which appears to list Printec Slovakia) that expose the local integrator layer no register captures. The strongest find of this cell is bank-side rather than vendor-side: Slovenská sporiteľňa's GDPR processor-list PDF names actual suppliers including Diebold Nixdorf s.r.o., a pattern that should be replicated across every SK bank and paired with PMÚ/EU merger decisions and public procurement records. Priority next steps are querying the vendor partner locators with a Slovakia filter and harvesting each SK bank's 'zoznam sprostredkovateľov' disclosure.
